data.title: 贝尔法斯特 · 雨中的伞
data.description: 港区突然下雨，贝尔法斯特停在台阶旁撑开伞，侧身为身旁画外的人留出一半伞面。
data.promptProse: Caught in a sudden port shower beside wet granite steps, Belfast pauses in her slate-blue harbor coat and dark long skirt beneath an open dark umbrella. Holding the curved handle steady, she tilts the canopy slightly to one side and turns toward the viewer with a gentle, inviting smile, leaving generous dry shelter beside her shoulder. Cool overcast daylight shimmers across the falling rain streaks and wet stone treads.
data.animaCaption: Pausing beside the wet harbor stone steps in her slate-blue coat, Belfast holds her open umbrella angled slightly aside to share its shelter with the viewer. Soft overcast daylight catches raindrops gleaming off the umbrella rim and her gentle smile.
